decoy_patterns.cypher: MATCH (h:Dispute {id: 'DSP-HIST-C02'})-[:FILED_BY]->(x:CardMember), (y:CardMember {id: 'CMB-C01'}) WHERE x.name = y.name AND x.id <> y.id AND h.outcome = 'goodwill_credit' RETURN h, x, y
decoy_patterns.name: the earlier Offer goodwill went to a namesake, not this Card Member

intake: I spent $540 at Northwind with the $100-off Amex Offer and never got the $100. They overcharged me.
misleading_surface: The Card Member calls the missing Offer credit a Merchant overcharge, and a Daniel Okafor already received an Offer goodwill credit.

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-91003'})-[:DISPUTES]->(c:Charge)-[:CHARGED_TO]->(paid:Card)-[:CARRIED_BY]->(cm:CardMember), (o:Offer)-[:ENROLLED_ON]->(enrolled:Card)-[:CARRIED_BY]->(cm), (c)-[:AT_MERCHANT]->(m:Merchant)<-[:OFFER_AT]-(o) WHERE paid.id <> enrolled.id AND c.amount >= o.spend_threshold AND o.funded_by = 'amex' RETURN d, c, paid, enrolled, o, cm
proof_patterns.name: Amex Offer enrolled on another of the Card Member's own Cards, purchase met the threshold
